provided_assets.limitations: Visual correspondence does not prove file loading. Absent UI kits/fonts are not mandatory. Audio is not evaluated from images.
provided_assets.preview_scope: Representative actual image assets and bundled archive previews. Inventory includes all supplied files and archive entries. Not every 3D model has a render preview; do not imagine geometry from names or treat texture images as geometry.
provided_assets.usage_requirement: Evaluate effective use/adaptation of supplied material through visible realized roles, form, scale and integration. Do not count files or require every resource.

reference_video.limitations: No audio or source-code conclusions. Overview spacing cannot certify brief transitions or animation. Inspect dense excerpts or exact video frames for those claims. Source reference status is recorded separately.
reference_video.scope: Full-duration retained reference footage is the observable task target. Overview samples show displayed content; dense excerpts show sampled movement. Unshown behavior and current-build agreement remain unverified. Clip boundaries are selection artifacts.

statement:
# Apex Circuit — task brief

This is a design target, not an implementation specification. Build your own GDD, scene structure, rules, and code.

## Target player experience

Drive from a chase view, commit to braking and cornering decisions, race a complete circuit, and receive an unambiguous result.

## Scope boundary

A compact third-person circuit racer with a start, timed or opponent pressure, lap progression, finish order, failure or loss, and restart.

## Creative freedom

You may design the circuit, handling model, rivals, lap count, and presentation.
